## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：① 身份类对象（团队、用户、成员等 `better-auth` 表）的说明从「由身份提供方管理」改为「经内置身份服务写入」，正文说明用本页操作或登录/邀请/安全流程增改记录，10 个语言包同改，只改值不增删键；② 记录页上声明 `refreshAfter: true` 的操作成功后，除了重读本记录，还刷新本页列出的每个关联对象，关联列表重取、标签页与卡片计数重算。
- 为什么改：在 Setup 手工建的团队被标成「由身份提供方管理」，读起来像外部同步来的、不能改；用表头「添加成员」加人后，「团队成员」标签页仍显示 0（列表却有 2 条），要等列表里删一个人才追上。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 的刷新范围（新增 `notifyViewChanged`，五处 `refreshAfter` 入口改用它）和文案；不动 spec、服务端、元数据。代价是带 `refreshAfter` 的操作后多发几次子列表读取，父记录仍只读一次（测试钉住）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `notifyViewChanged` 与 `pageChildObjectsRef` → `RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx` 末尾的 #30337 describe → `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `managedByBadge.betterAuth`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/components/__tests__/ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx`，预期 10/10 通过（在 main 源码上新增的 3 条失败）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。卡的第 2 项（成员行「标题」列显示原始 id）是 server 半边，见 Acceptance notes，席位另立单。

## What changes

The card's three Expected bullets, and what this PR does for each:

> The label says something true of a team made here, or does not appear.

Done. `sys_team` declares `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, and that bucket is right: the identity service owns the table and every write to it goes through that service's endpoints (the team's own actions). The words were wrong. The `managedByBadge.betterAuth` note now reads "Written through the built-in identity service" / 「经内置身份服务写入」, and its body says these records are created and changed with the actions on the page or through sign-in, invitation and security flows, all of which go through that service. That holds for every `better-auth` object, a hand-made team included, and it names no outside provider. Values change in all ten packs and in `ManagedByBadge`'s English fallback; no key is added or removed. What the bucket means for other objects is unchanged: the badge still draws for the same objects, under the same authoring gate, with the same CRUD affordances hidden.

> Member rows read as names. If the title column adds nothing beside 用户, it goes.

Not in this PR: only the server can fix it without the renderer second-guessing declared metadata. See Acceptance notes.

> The tab count matches the list as soon as members change.

Done. The tab badge reads `RelatedCountStore`, keyed on the CHILD object (`sys_team_member`) and invalidated by the data-change bus under that name. The team's header action `add_team_member` (`type: 'api'`, `refreshAfter: true`) succeeded and the page posted only `sys_team` and this record. So the count cached when the team had no members stayed 0, and the list read fresh when its tab opened. A row action on the membership list posts `sys_team_member`, which is why the count caught up after a removal.

- `refreshAfter` is the spec's "Refresh view after execution". On a record page the view is the record and its related lists, so the page now refreshes both: `notifyViewChanged` posts this record's change and then one change per child object the page lists (`childRelations` plus authored `record:related_list` / `record:reference_rail` children, the same set the child-write subscription reads). The lists refetch, the counts re-count, and the parent row is still read once, because the bumps land in one batch.
- It is used at every `refreshAfter` entry on the page: the `api` action door, the direct `api` fetch, the declared-operation script path, the flow launch, and the server action handler's `onRefresh`. An action's target is opaque to the client, so the page cannot know which objects it wrote. The undo path and form saves keep the record-only refresh.

## Tests

- `ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe (#30337): the `better-auth` tooltip in English (fallback) and in Chinese (zh pack, through `I18nProvider`) names the built-in identity service and the page's actions, and does not contain "identity provider" / 「身份提供方」.
- `RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe (#30337) on the same harness: a header `type: 'api'` action with `refreshAfter: true` whose door adds a child row server-side. After the click the list shows the new row, `RelatedCountStore` reads 3 (it was 2), and the parent is read exactly once more. The harness's authenticated fetch is now a hoisted spy that answers nothing unless a test gives it an implementation, as the bare `vi.fn()` did.
- `RecordDetailView.setupManagedByChip-13385.test.tsx`: the two header-note expectations follow the new title.
- Red first, on `4779e798` (tests only): `Tests 3 failed | 7 passed (10)`. The two badge tests got the old note. The header-action test found the door call but `Unable to find an element with the text: Support plan`, because the list never refetched. Green after the fix: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)`. The red leg on the parent commit is the ablation: the fix is the only source change, and app-shell tests import `src`.
- Every ui test file that names `RecordDetailView`, `ManagedByBadge` or `managedByBadge`, plus all of `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 382 passed (382)`, `Tests 3754 passed | 13 skipped (3767)` (under the verify lock, 17m12s).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2` (under the verify lock): `Tasks: 69 successful, 69 total`.
- `eslint` on the changed ui files: 0 errors. `RecordDetailView.tsx` has 124 warnings against 123 on main: one more `react-hooks/refs` heuristic warning on the `withNewTabUrlFastPath(apiHandler, …)` memo, because `apiHandler` now reaches a ref through `notifyViewChanged` inside a callback. The other files carry no new warnings.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 is the server half** (triage on the card says the same). The 标题 column is `sys_team_member.display_title`, the object's declared `nameField`, a formula `record.user_id + ' in ' + record.team_id`. A formula is evaluated on the stored row before `$expand`, so it can only ever draw the two ids. A related list with no authored columns leads with the declared name (`leadWithNameField`, ADR-0079), which exempts a declared `nameField` by design, and then takes `highlightFields` (`user_id`, then `team_id`, dropped as the key back to the team, then `created_at`). The renderer cannot tell that this title adds nothing without parsing the formula, which is second-guessing declared metadata (`ui/AGENTS.md` #0.1). The producer-side fix sits in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-team-member.object.ts`, outside this card's file surface: `relatedListColumns: ['user_id', 'created_at']` on the `team_id` lookup (and `['team_id', 'created_at']` on `user_id` for the user page's teams list). Authored relationship columns are drawn as written, with no name lead, so the member list would read 用户 / 创建时间. Reported to the seat to file. This PR says `Part of`, so merging it leaves the card open for that half.
- `refreshAfter` refreshes more than it did on a record page. That is the spec's wording ("the view"), and the change stays inside the page's own lists. It is not a `'*'`: other mounted views are not refetched.
